dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.subtitle: Interactive visualizations with sample data — a foundation for plugging in real data soon.
dashboards.mockDataNotice: The data shown below is fictional (mock data), used only to illustrate how the dashboard works.
dashboards.xgBody: Comparison between xG (expected goals) and actual goals scored across a sequence of ten matches. When actual goals sit well above xG, it signals above-expected efficiency (or luck); when below, it points to wasted clear chances.
dashboards.radarBody: Multi-dimensional comparison between two midfielders across metrics such as progressive passes, tackles, expected assists and duels won. The radar makes each player's profile easy to see beyond the naked eye.
dashboards.evolutionBody: Time series showing the evolution of a team's PPDA (passes per defensive action) across match days, indicating how intense the team's pressing has been in recent matches.
dashboards.realDataBody: Standings, top scorers and other real analysis, updated automatically every day.

brasileirao.title: Brasileirão and International Leagues
brasileirao.subtitle: Standings, top scorers and other real-time analysis from the Brasileirão and the world's top leagues.
brasileirao.mockDataNotice: We haven't received the first automatic update of real data for this competition yet — the numbers below are just placeholder examples (zeroed out).
brasileirao.scorersSubtitle: Goal-scoring ranking for the current season.
brasileirao.homeAwaySubtitle: How each team performs as home and away side — shows how much performance depends on home advantage.
brasileirao.streaksSubtitle: Teams ranked by their longest unbeaten streak.
brasileirao.attackDefenseSubtitle: Goals scored vs goals conceded per game for each team — teams in the bottom-right corner attack well and concede little; the top-left corner is the opposite.
brasileirao.raceSubtitle: Accumulated points of the current top 10, matchday by matchday — each line in the team's color.
